title: Norse Saga officially launches across Southeast Asia

blocks.text: PlayPark, with Ujoy Games, officially launches Norse Saga today across Southeast Asia. Available on Android and iOS in Thailand, Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, and Vietnam, the new fantasy adventure invites players to explore the Nine Realms, build powerful characters, collect Star Spirits, and battle their way to the top.

items: Emulator: MuMu Emulator, Android 10+, VT enabled

blocks.text: *Gift code rewards are valid from 15-30 September 2026.
Rise Through ‘The Conquerer – HALL OF FAME’ Ranking and Win Exclusive Prizes!

Compete for a share of over US$3,000 in prizes, including the new iPhone 18 Pro! Whether battling in PvP or developing characters and companions, every adventure is a chance to climb the rankings and claim exclusive rewards. More details here: LINK
Unlock ‘Raphael’ Epic Star Spirit with Seven Days Login Gifts
Claim Hero Stars, Equipment, Bound Diamonds, and more. On Day 7, players can claim Raphael, the Epic Star Spirit, a powerful healing companion to support their journey.
Discover More at the Norse Saga Webshop
Players can visit the Webshop to explore available packages, exclusive promotions, and other items designed to support their journey beyond myth in the most effective way possible!

Explore the breathtaking world of Norse Saga alongside adorable Star Spirit companions, where ancient ruins, magical technology, and legendary adventures await. Together, uncover hidden secrets and join forces with the Goddess of Fate to protect the World Tree from the World Ender.
